name: GateHub Euro
oneLiner: EURGH is Dinaro's euro e-money token, distributed through GateHub on XRP Ledger and Xahau with at-par redemption through SEPA.
launchPhaseDetail: Dinaro d.o.o. issues EURGH as a euro e-money token under MiCA. The Bank of Slovenia register confirms its electronic money authorisation, granted on November 2 2021. The white paper dates publication and the start of the public offer or admission to trading to September 1 2026. GateHub's November 5 announcement says EURGH is available through its XRP Ledger and Xahau wallets, with issuance against received euros and at-par redemption through SEPA, subject to legal and verification requirements. Public XRPL gateway_balances and account_lines reads on November 8 2026 confirm outstanding EURGH issued by the account named in the announcement. Pharos retains the launched pre-launch status because no price lane and no supply lane have been admitted.

milestones.title: EURGH white paper dates the start of its public offer
milestones.description: Dinaro's MiCA white paper gives September 1 2026 as both its publication date and the starting date of the offer to the public or admission to trading. This is the documented offer start, not a verified first issuance date.

milestones.title: GateHub announces EURGH distribution with Dinaro
milestones.description: GateHub announces the euro e-money token issued by Dinaro on XRP Ledger and Xahau. The release identifies the issuer account and currency code, describes funding through SEPA and gives holders at-par redemption rights subject to legal and verification requirements.

listingStatusReview.reason: Missing lanes: no admitted price lane and no admitted supply lane. Public XRPL issuance is verified, but neither runtime lane has been admitted for EURGH.
